status: recorded before any episode in this study
claim_scope: paired targeted development evidence on consumed repositories; not a generalization or leaderboard estimate
hypothesis: when Minimal-B historically exhausts the request cap before candidate formation, operation-linked executable compatibility deltas improve the probability of producing a valid Official-passing deployment without constraining the Agent's operation choice

control.description: continuous free Agent search, the shared narrow evaluator-artifact boundary, repeatedly callable clean replay, and terminal delivery on replay Pass; no compatibility frontier

treatment.description: the matched control plus initial and operation-triggered complete-goal observations, with only the newest valid compatibility state fully visible

comparison.only_treatment_difference: the required inspect/change operation annotation that triggers executable compatibility observation, plus latest-state frontier feedback

execution.arm_order: counterbalanced by pair and interleaved over two concurrent Spark lanes

primary_endpoint: paired valid Official EnvBench Pass@1; generation noncompletion is Fail
mechanism_endpoints: whether operation-triggered observations are valid and identity-bound
obligation transition sequence and first zero-obligation state
whether frontier feedback changes the next substantive operation
Fail-to-Pass replay repair and replay-Official agreement
secondary_endpoints: deployment completeness and validity as separate quality axes
decision_rule: fewer treatment Official passes rejects the candidate
more treatment Official passes retains the candidate for a larger fixed development comparison
a success tie with both arms failing every case rejects the candidate
any other success tie is adjudicated by causal frontier use and common-outcome resources, with success remaining primary and no hard token or cost threshold
censoring: only documented provider, source-acquisition, container, or Official-evaluator infrastructure failures may be retried under a written identical-semantics amendment; algorithm noncompletion is not censored
